item.description:
Release v5.7.6

Changes since v5.7.5

  • docs(MessageListAppKit): native plugin implementation plan
  • feat(ConversationManager): add markConversationActive to bump conversations to top on new messages
  • feat(ConversationManaging,StateMonitorPlugin): introduce global verbosity with bidirectional sync
  • feat(DeepSeek): add DeepSeek LLM provider plugin with OpenAI and Anthropic support
  • feat(DeepSeek): stabilize prompt prefix and echo thinking blocks to raise cache hit rate
  • feat(LumiKernel,MessageRenderer): explicit renderer routing via preferredRendererID
  • feat(MessageList,MessageManager,AgentTurnRunner): let status message span an entire AgentTurn
  • feat(MessageList): scroll performance optimization — LazyVStack, incremental streaming parse, sender signal debounce
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add immutable row snapshots and V1/V2 projectors
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add narrow subscriptions, pagination, and refresh coalescing
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add native code, table, and mermaid block views
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add native markdown document and layout cache pipeline
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add native scroll anchoring and bottom-follow
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add native table shell with incremental data source
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add native TextKit markdown prose rendering
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add native tool, tool-group, attachment, and ask_user renderers
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): add renderer registry and core native renderers
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): integrate streaming with dynamic heights and stable-ID swaps
  • feat(MessageListAppKit): scaffold disabled native plugin
  • feat(MessageRenderer): add collapsible reasoning block for assistant messages
